title: Prove that this exact change is ready to ship
description: Select a change, then assemble the evidence bundle. The gate checks named requirements and the approval path; it does not average unrelated signals into a score.

evidence.label: Artifact and data lineage
evidence.detail: Immutable model, prompt, code, data, configuration, and dependency references.

evidence.label: Decision-quality evaluation
evidence.detail: Task metrics and acceptance criteria on representative, versioned evaluation data.

evidence.label: Subgroup impact analysis
evidence.detail: Relevant outcome and error rates with sample sizes, uncertainty, and review notes.

evidence.label: Security and misuse review
evidence.detail: Abuse paths, access boundaries, data exposure, tool permissions, and mitigations.

evidence.label: Human oversight exercise
evidence.detail: Reviewer context, authority, queue capacity, override, escalation, and appeal are tested.

evidence.label: Restriction and rollback drill
evidence.detail: Operators prove they can reduce authority, route to people, or restore the prior version.

changes.label: Decision-threshold change
changes.detail: The artifact is unchanged, but the operating point changes who receives positive and negative outcomes.
changes.risk: Error trade-offs and subgroup outcomes may move immediately.
changes.approver: System owner and independent impact reviewer
changes.expiry: Re-evaluate after material population or label drift

changes.label: New training data source
changes.detail: A new source can change coverage, labels, consent assumptions, leakage, and representation.
changes.risk: Quality can improve while privacy, provenance, or subgroup behavior regresses.
changes.approver: Data owner, security, and independent impact reviewer
changes.expiry: Re-evaluate when source collection or licensing changes

changes.label: Grant autonomous action
changes.detail: The system may execute an external action without a person approving each decision.
changes.risk: A recommendation error becomes an immediate side effect and can propagate at machine speed.
changes.approver: Senior accountable authority independent of the model owner
changes.expiry: Re-evaluate after tool, permission, scope, or affected-population changes
